subject.title: fix: unify macos dashboard auth startup

question: Should embedded macOS Dashboard browser auth receive native/stored operator device tokens, or only configured shared gateway token/password credentials?
rationale: This PR fixes fast-path parity by extending the existing resolved-token helper to another browser startup path, but the sibling security report and PR ask for the opposite boundary, so automation should not decide the credential policy.

options.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
options.body: Keep the shared presentation helper but feed browser Dashboard URL/native auth only configured shared token/password credentials, then update or close the conflicting native-token parity PR.

options.title: Approve native-token parity
options.body: Maintain the native/operator token fallback for both Dashboard paths, but require explicit maintainer approval plus macOS proof showing the security and upgrade behavior is intentional.

options.title: Pause both drafts
options.body: Leave both auth PRs open but blocked until a macOS owner/security reviewer writes the durable Dashboard browser-auth policy.

recommendation.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
recommendation.body: Keep the shared presentation helper but feed browser Dashboard URL/native auth only configured shared token/password credentials, then update or close the conflicting native-token parity PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the native Dashboard window and endpoint/auth reload behavior touched by this policy choice.
